description: This Java source file defines a SAX handler class 'UserProfileHandler' responsible for parsing XML files related to user profiles for ECU configurations. It extracts profile parameters, switches, external settings, and protocol information, and constructs a UserProfile object from the parsed data.

classes.name: UserProfileHandler
classes.description: A SAX parser handler that processes XML elements to build a UserProfile object containing profile parameters, switches, external items, and protocol info.

methods.name: startDocument
methods.description: Initializes the maps for parameters, switches, and external items at the beginning of XML parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of each XML element, storing relevant data into internal maps based on element tags and attributes.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Creates and returns a UserProfile object populated with the parsed data.

methods.name: getUserProfileItem
methods.description: Constructs and returns a UserProfileItem based on the attributes of the current XML element.
